options.name: azure_base_url
options.description: The URL to the base container of an Azure Storage account to write backups to.

options.name: azure_credential
options.description: The name of the credential on the SQL instance that can write to the I(azure_base_url), only needed if using Storage access keys If using SAS credentials, the command will look for a credential with a name matching the I(azure_base_url).

options.name: block_size
options.description: Specifies block size to use.

options.name: buffer_count
options.description: Number of I/O buffers to use.

options.name: build_path
options.description: By default this command will not attempt to create missing paths, this switch will change the behaviour so that it will.

options.name: checksum
options.description: If set, the backup checksum will be calculated.

options.name: compress
options.description: If set, use compression when creating the backup if it is supported by the version and edition.

options.name: copy_only
options.description: The backup will be CopyOnly.

options.name: create_folder
options.description: If set, database is backed up to its own subfolder within the path.

options.name: database
options.description: The database to process.

options.name: encryption_algorithm
options.description: Specifies the Encryption Algorithm to used.

options.name: encryption_certificate
options.description: The name of the certificate to be used to encrypt the backups.

options.name: file_count
options.description: The number of striped files to create the backup with.

options.name: file_path
options.description: The name of the file to backup to. If no name is specified then the backup files will be named C(DatabaseName_yyyyMMddHHmm) (i.e. C(Database1_201714022131))

options.name: ignore_file_checks
options.description: If set, stops the function from checking path validity.

options.name: increment_prefix
options.description: If set, this will prefix backup files with an incrementing integer (ie; C(1-), C(2-)). Using this has been alleged to improved restore times on some Azure based SQL Database platforms.

options.name: initialize
options.description: Initializes the media as part of the backup operation.

options.name: max_transfer_size
options.description: Sets the size of the unit of transfer. Values must be a multiple of 64kb.

options.name: no_recovery
options.description: If set, performs a tail log backup.

options.name: path
options.description: Path in which to place the backup files. If not specified, the backups will be placed in the default backup location for SqlInstance.

options.name: replace_in_name
options.description: If set, the following list of strings will be replaced in the FilePath and Path strings. C(instancename) - will be replaced with the instance Name C(servername) - will be replaced with the server name C(dbname) - will be replaced with the database name C(timestamp) - will be replaced with the timestamp (either the default, or the format provided) C(backuptype) - will be replaced with C(Full), C(Log), or C(Differential) as appropriate

options.name: sql_instance
options.description: The SQL Server instance to modify.

options.name: sql_password
options.description: Password for SQL Authentication.

options.name: sql_username
options.description: Username for SQL Authentication.

options.name: timestamp_format
options.description: By default the command timestamps backups using the format C(yyyyMMddHHmm). Using this option this can be overridden.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of backup to perform.

options.name: verify
options.description: If set, the backup will be verified via C(RESTORE VERIFYONLY)

options.name: with_format
options.description: Formats the media as the first step of the backup operation.
